name_ar: جرد العوامل الداخلية والخارجية المؤثرة في الاستمرارية
en: PESTLE / SWOT analysis document listing internal capabilities and external threats relevant to BCM; annual review record signed by BCM owner

name_ar: تحديد توقعات الأطراف المعنية واحتياجاتها
en: Stakeholder register with identified BCM obligations (regulatory, contractual, reputational); documented review cycle; evidence of regulatory requirements captured (SAMA, NCA, NCEMA)

name_ar: تحديد نطاق إدارة استمرارية الأعمال وحدوده
en: Approved BCM scope statement referencing organisational boundaries, locations, products/services, and exclusions; board or executive sign-off minute

name_ar: نظام إدارة استمرارية الأعمال وعملياته
en: Process map or RACI chart for the BCMS lifecycle; documented interaction between BCM processes and the broader management system; version-controlled BCMS manual or programme charter

name_ar: تحديد الأنشطة الحرجة والتبعيات التشغيلية
en: Critical-activity register with upstream/downstream dependencies (people, technology, third parties, facilities); linkage to BIA output; reviewed and approved by department heads

name_ar: التزام الإدارة العليا ومساءلتها في استمرارية الأعمال
en: Board resolution or executive committee minute mandating BCM programme; annual BCM performance report presented to board; evidence of budget allocation for BCM activities

name_ar: سياسة استمرارية الأعمال — المحتوى والاعتماد
en: Approved BCM policy document (with version history) covering objectives, scope, regulatory alignment, review cycle, and consequence of non-compliance; board/CEO sign-off minute; published policy accessible to all staff

name_ar: أدوار استمرارية الأعمال ومسؤولياتها وصلاحياتها
en: BCMS RACI matrix covering BCM owner, crisis management team (CMT), business continuity coordinator per BU, IT DR lead, and communications officer; documented in policy or separate governance charter; updated upon org changes

name_en: BCM Objectives Alignment with Strategic Direction
name_ar: توافق أهداف استمرارية الأعمال مع التوجه الاستراتيجي
en: BCM objectives documented in the annual BCM plan and traceable to the organisation's strategic objectives; KPIs defined per objective; progress reviewed at management review

name_ar: إجراءات معالجة المخاطر والفرص في استمرارية الأعمال
en: BCM risk register identifying risks to achieving BCMS outcomes; documented risk treatment plan; linkage to enterprise risk register; reviewed at least annually and after significant incidents

name_en: BCM Objectives & Planning to Achieve Them
name_ar: أهداف استمرارية الأعمال وخطط تحقيقها
en: Documented BCM objectives with owner, target date, success measure, and resource requirements; embedded in annual BCM programme plan; progress tracked in management-review dashboard

name_ar: إدارة التغيير داخل نظام إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
en: Change-management log for BCMS updates (policy, scope, plans); impact-assessment template applied before changes take effect; communication of changes to relevant stakeholders on record

name_ar: كفاية موارد استمرارية الأعمال
en: Approved BCM budget line in annual financial plan; resource inventory (staff, alternate sites, tooling, vendors); gap analysis reviewed by BCM owner and signed off by executive sponsor

name_ar: كفاءة العاملين في استمرارية الأعمال وسجلات التدريب
en: Competency framework for BCM roles (BCM coordinator, CMT members, IT DR staff); training completion records (classroom, tabletop, e-learning); skills gap assessment with closure plan; annual refresher schedule

name_ar: برنامج التوعية باستمرارية الأعمال
en: Annual BCM awareness calendar (campaigns, intranet articles, tabletop teasers); completion tracking per department; post-awareness survey results; awareness content approved by BCM owner

name_ar: خطة التواصل في استمرارية الأعمال (الداخلية والخارجية)
en: Documented communication plan covering: what to communicate, when, to whom (staff, customers, regulators, media), via which channel, and who is authorised spokesperson; tested in at least one exercise per year; escalation thresholds defined

name_ar: ضبط المعلومات الموثقة والاحتفاظ بها
en: Document control procedure covering naming convention, version control, approval workflow, distribution list, retention periods, and secure off-site/cloud backup of BCM documents; document register reviewed quarterly

name_ar: منهجية تحليل تأثير الأعمال وحوكمته
en: Approved BIA methodology document defining impact criteria (financial, operational, reputational, regulatory), time horizons, scoring scale, and review frequency; signed off by BCM owner and executive sponsor

name_en: BIA Worksheets per Critical Activity / Service
name_ar: أوراق عمل تحليل التأثير لكل نشاط حرج وخدمة حرجة
en: Completed BIA worksheets for each critical service/process: owner, description, dependencies, impact ratings per time horizon, agreed RTO/RPO/MTPD/MBCO; signed off by process owner and BCM coordinator; version-dated

name_en: RTO / RPO / MTPD / MBCO Definition & Sign-off
name_ar: تحديد أهداف وقت الاسترداد ونقطة الاسترداد والمدة القصوى للانقطاع والحد الأدنى لمستوى الأعمال واعتمادها
en: Consolidated RTO/RPO/MTPD/MBCO register per critical service with executive sign-off; alignment evidence to SAMA impact-tolerance statement; annual review record with change log

name_ar: تحديد متطلبات الموارد الحرجة اللازمة للاسترداد
en: Resource dependency matrix per critical activity covering staff (minimum numbers and skills), IT systems, data, facilities, third-party services, and utilities; gaps between minimum requirements and alternate-site capacity documented

name_ar: دورة مراجعة تحليل التأثير والتحديث المبني على المحفزات
en: Documented BIA review policy (annual minimum + triggered by material change — new product, M&A, technology refresh, incident); review completion records; change log entries linked to triggering events

name_ar: تحديد تهديدات استمرارية الأعمال ومكتبة السيناريوهات
en: Documented threat/scenario library (natural disasters, cyber incidents, power outages, pandemics, civil unrest, supplier failure, key-person dependency) tailored to Saudi operating context; reviewed by risk management and BCM teams

name_en: BCM Risk Register — Likelihood, Impact & Rating
name_ar: سجل مخاطر استمرارية الأعمال — الاحتمالية والتأثير والتقييم
en: BCM risk register with threat scenarios rated on likelihood × impact matrix; risk owners assigned; residual-risk rating after existing controls; linked to BIA critical-activity priorities; maintained in GRC system or controlled spreadsheet

name_ar: قرارات معالجة مخاطر الاستمرارية وربطها بالضوابط
en: Risk treatment register showing accept/mitigate/transfer/avoid decisions per risk; controls mapped to each risk; residual-risk acceptances signed by risk owner and BCM owner; escalation to risk committee for high-rated residuals

name_ar: مخاطر استمرارية الأعمال للأطراف الثالثة وسلسلة التوريد
en: Third-party BCM risk assessment (critical suppliers/vendors); contractual BCM requirements (RTO SLAs, DR testing obligations, notification requirements); evidence of supplier BCM attestations or audit results; contingency sourcing plan for critical single-source suppliers

name_ar: تحليل خيارات الاستراتيجية واختيارها
en: Recovery strategy options paper per critical activity covering: do nothing, manual workaround, alternate site (warm/hot/cold), work-from-home, mutual-aid agreement, cloud failover; cost-benefit analysis; selected strategy approved by executive sponsor

name_ar: توفير الموارد اللازمة لتنفيذ استراتيجيات الاسترداد
en: Alternate-site configuration records (seats, connectivity, licences, equipment); DR infrastructure build/test records; WFH toolkit inventory; SLA agreements with alternate-site or cloud providers; budget allocation for strategy implementation

name_ar: استراتيجية التعافي من كوارث تقنية المعلومات وبنيتها
en: IT DR strategy document covering RPO/RTO per system tier; DR architecture diagram (primary–DR site replication topology); data backup and restore policy with test records; cloud-based failover design where applicable; aligned to SAMA technology risk requirements

name_ar: استمرارية الكفاءات البشرية وتخفيف مخاطر الاعتماد على الأفراد الرئيسيين
en: Key-person risk register; documented succession/cover plans for critical roles; cross-training records; contact tree (alternate contacts per role); HR emergency-response roster; evidence of succession plan tests in tabletop exercises

name_ar: التكرار في الاتصالات والتواصل
en: Network resilience design document (dual ISP, MPLS + internet failover, satellite backup); tested failover scenario records; out-of-band communication tools inventory (satellite phones, emergency messaging platform); SAMA notification channel readiness confirmation

name_ar: خطة استمرارية الأعمال — الهيكل والمحتوى
en: Approved master BCP document covering: purpose, scope, activation criteria, CMT structure, escalation chain, communication plan, recovery procedures per critical activity; version-controlled; off-site and offline copy maintained; last review date evidenced

name_ar: خطة إدارة الأزمات وهيكل القيادة
en: Crisis Management Plan defining CMT composition (Gold/Silver/Bronze or equivalent), decision-making authorities, crisis room setup, spokesperson designation, escalation matrix, and stand-down procedures; CMT contact list (current); rehearsed in CMT tabletop at least annually

name_ar: أدلة تشغيل التعافي من كوارث تقنية المعلومات
en: Step-by-step DR runbooks per critical system/application covering: failover trigger, pre-conditions, numbered recovery steps, validation tests, roll-back procedure, and responsible team; runbooks version-controlled and accessible in DR site or cloud vault; last tested date recorded

name_ar: إجراءات إخطار الحوادث والتصعيد
en: Documented incident notification matrix defining who to notify (internal tiers, regulators, customers, media) based on incident severity/type/duration; escalation timeline (e.g., SAMA notification within X hours); template notification messages approved; tested in exercises

name_ar: إجراءات تفعيل موقع الاسترداد والعمل عن بُعد
en: Recovery site activation checklist (step-by-step with owners and timing); remote-working activation guide (VPN capacity, device policy, application access confirmation); travel/logistics plan for key staff relocation; site readiness assessment records

name_ar: إجراءات الاسترداد بعد الحادث والعودة إلى الوضع الطبيعي
en: Stand-down and return-to-normal procedures covering: recovery verification criteria, data-integrity checks, system sign-off, primary-site reinstatement, lessons-learned trigger; documented in BCP appendix; reviewed after each activation

name_ar: برنامج التمارين — الجدول الزمني والنطاق
en: Annual BCM exercise programme document covering: exercise types (awareness walk-through, tabletop, simulation, full failover), schedule, objectives, scope per exercise, responsible owners; approved by BCM governance body; communicated to relevant departments

name_ar: سجلات التمارين المكتبية ومحاكاة الحوادث
en: Tabletop/simulation exercise records including: scenario description, participants, observations/findings, actions raised; after-action report (AAR) signed by exercise lead; improvement items logged in BCM action tracker; evidence of closure

name_ar: سجلات اختبارات الفشل التقني في التعافي من الكوارث
en: DR failover test plans and results per critical system: test objectives, RPO/RTO achieved vs. target, pass/fail per test step, defects found, remediation completed, sign-off by IT DR lead and business owner; tested at minimum annually (SAMA requirement: semi-annually for critical systems)

name_ar: نتائج التمارين وتتبع التحسينات
en: BCM improvement log consolidating findings from all exercises and tests; each item with owner, priority, due date, and status; reviewed monthly by BCM coordinator; presented to management review; trend analysis for recurring themes

name_ar: الاختبارات الإلزامية بموجب إطار البنك المركزي للمرونة الإلكترونية والسيناريوهات
en: Cyber-resilience test plan and results (threat-led penetration testing, ransomware recovery simulation, SWIFT environment DR); SAMA scenario test evidence (e.g., simultaneous site loss + cyber incident dual-scenario); results shared with CISO and BCM owner; regulatory submission where required

name_ar: مراقبة وقياس أداء استمرارية الأعمال
en: BCM KPI dashboard covering: % BCPs tested per schedule, RTO/RPO achievement in tests, open improvement-action closure rate, BIA currency (age), staff awareness completion rate, exercise frequency compliance; reviewed quarterly by BCM owner

name_ar: التدقيق الداخلي لنظام إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
en: Annual internal BCM audit plan; audit reports with findings, nonconformity ratings, and corrective-action requirements; evidence of auditor independence (not auditing own work); management response to findings; closure evidence for major NCs

name_ar: مراجعة الإدارة — المدخلات والمخرجات والمحاضر
en: Management review meeting minutes (at minimum annual) covering mandatory inputs: audit results, exercise findings, BCM performance KPIs, changes to context/risks, regulatory feedback, corrective actions status; documented decisions and action items with owners and dates

name_ar: تتبع الامتثال للمتطلبات التنظيمية وشهادات الاعتماد
en: Compliance register mapping BCMS controls to ISO 22301:2019, SAMA BCM Framework, and NCEMA requirements; compliance status (compliant/partial/non-compliant) per requirement; evidence links; annual refresh; gap closure plan for partials and non-conformities

name_ar: عملية معالجة عدم المطابقة والإجراءات التصحيحية
en: Nonconformity log with root-cause analysis, corrective action plan, owner, target date, and verification of effectiveness; linkage to audit, exercise, and incident findings; management review of overdue items; trend analysis for systemic issues

name_ar: التحسين المستمر — الفرص والابتكارات
en: Annual BCMS improvement roadmap capturing lessons from exercises, incidents, regulatory changes, and benchmarking; innovation items (e.g., automation of DR failover, AI-based incident detection); approved by BCM owner; progress tracked quarterly

name_ar: الدروس المستفادة من الحوادث الفعلية
en: Post-incident review (PIR) report for each BCM activation (including near-misses): timeline reconstruction, root cause, plan effectiveness assessment, gaps identified, improvement actions raised; PIR completed within 30 days of stand-down; findings fed into BIA and risk assessment updates

name_ar: إشراف مجلس الإدارة والإدارة العليا على استمرارية الأعمال
en: Board-approved BCM policy and annual BCM report; board or risk-committee agenda item on BCM at least annually; documented board-level escalation path for BCM activations exceeding defined thresholds; board attestation to SAMA where required

name_en: Impact Tolerance Statement for Critical Operations
name_ar: بيان تحمل التأثير للعمليات الحرجة
en: Formal impact tolerance statement per critical operation specifying the maximum tolerable level of disruption (time and degradation); methodology used; board approval evidence; alignment with BIA-derived MTPD/MBCO; annual review and SAMA submission record

name_ar: تحديد العمليات الحرجة وترتيب أولوياتها
en: SAMA-aligned critical-operations register listing services that, if disrupted, would cause material harm to customers, financial stability, or regulatory compliance; prioritisation rationale; linkage to BIA; reviewed annually and after material business changes

name_ar: اختبارات السيناريوهات المطلوبة من البنك المركزي السعودي
en: Annual scenario test schedule including SAMA-specified severe-but-plausible scenarios (e.g., data-centre complete loss, cyber attack, simultaneous pandemic + cyber, payment-system failure); test reports with RTO/RPO achieved; SAMA submission of results where required; senior-management sign-off

name_ar: إخطار الجهات التنظيمية عند الحوادث والتغييرات الجوهرية
en: Documented SAMA notification procedure covering: trigger criteria (incident type, duration, customer impact threshold), notification timeline (e.g., initial notice within 2 hours, follow-up within 24 hours), responsible officer, template notification messages; notification log for all incidents; post-incident regulatory report records

name_ar: دمج المرونة الإلكترونية مع استمرارية الأعمال
en: Documented integration between BCM and cyber-incident response (shared escalation criteria, joint CMT activation triggers, shared communication plan); ransomware recovery playbook tested at least annually; evidence of NCA and SAMA cybersecurity framework alignment within BCM plans

name_ar: التقييم الذاتي لمتطلبات البنك المركزي والمراجعة المستقلة
en: Completed SAMA BCM Framework self-assessment with evidence references per requirement; independent (internal audit or external assurance) review of BCM capability at SAMA-specified frequency; submission to SAMA on schedule; management response to review findings

name_ar: واجهة التنسيق مع المركز الوطني لإدارة الطوارئ وأدوار التنسيق
en: Documented NCEMA liaison role within CMT; contact directory for NCEMA and relevant national emergency-management authorities; organisation's place in sector/national response hierarchy documented; briefing notes/registration evidence with NCEMA if required by sector

name_en: Alignment with National Emergency Response Plans
name_ar: التوافق مع خطط الاستجابة الوطنية للطوارئ
en: Gap assessment mapping organisational BCP to relevant national emergency plans (sector contingency plans, NCEMA national crisis plan); alignment actions documented and tracked; BCM activation procedures reference national coordination protocols

name_en: Participation in National & Sector BCM Exercises
name_ar: المشاركة في التمارين الوطنية وتمارين الاستمرارية على مستوى القطاع
en: Participation records in NCEMA or sector-level BCM exercises (invitation, attendance confirmation, exercise report, lessons-learned input); internal debrief incorporating national-exercise findings; improvements actioned and evidenced

name_en: Incident Reporting to NCEMA & National Authorities
name_ar: الإبلاغ عن الحوادث للمركز الوطني لإدارة الطوارئ والجهات الوطنية
en: Notification procedure for reporting to NCEMA and relevant national authorities (criteria, timeline, channel, authorised officer, template); record of all national-authority notifications; post-incident national reporting submissions; national-authority feedback log

name_ar: التوافق مع سجل المخاطر الوطني
en: Review record of NCEMA national risk register or Saudi national risk landscape; evidence that nationally identified risks (e.g., pandemic, earthquake, extreme weather, regional conflict) are reflected in organisational BCM scenario library and BIA assumptions; annual alignment review
